notes: The Home Depot (homedepot.com). ACCESS: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Homepage, sitemap XML files, and /daily-deals fetch cleanly via direct HTTP (curl_cffi, tier 1) and headless Playwright with a real Chrome fingerprint (tier 2); every /b/, /c/, and /s/ path returns a consistent Akamai-edge 403 under both tiers, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's finding. Did not escalate to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) since it requires interactive browser selection this synchronous worker cannot perform, and tier 1+2 already produced a well-supported, evidence-based absence answer (not an access failure) - see below. DISCOVERY PERFORMED: (1) parsed the full current core-taxonomy sitemap (5,287 unfaceted category nodes) for New-Arrivals/New-In/Just-In/Just-Arrived/Latest-Arrivals/Whats-New/Recently-Added/New-Collection keywords - zero hits of any kind; (2) sampled 6 of the 44 faceted PLP_REFINED sitemap shards (~270,000 URLs) for the same keyword set - zero hits; (3) parsed the Collections sitemap (3,533 curated single-product-family pages) - zero hits for any New-Arrivals-style term; (4) parsed the Content/Article sitemap (2,997 editorial URLs) - zero New-Arrivals hits (only unrelated 'Trending' editorial/blog articles like trending-holiday-crafts, which are article pages, not PLPs, and not New-Arrivals-themed anyway); (5) inspected the rendered homepage's embedded Apollo state and the full 'Shop by Category' flyout tile list (extracted directly from JSON) - no New Arrivals / New In / Just Arrived / What's New tile or nav entry anywhere, only straight department links plus Labor Day Savings / Daily Deals / Special Savings promo tiles; (6) opened /daily-deals directly - a rotating deals/specials landing page, not a New Arrivals concept. CONCLUSION: no genuine New Arrivals PLP, 'New Collection' page, or any recently-added-products listing exists anywhere in Home Depot's current taxonomy, homepage nav, or promotional shelving that would need the 'Collection page needs inspection' test from the brief - there was no candidate 'New Collection'-style page to even inspect. Caveat: /b/ department landing pages are blocked outright (Akamai 403 under both HTTP and real-browser Playwright), so an in-department 'New Arrivals' shelf embedded only within a department page (with no independent sitemap-listed URL) could not be directly ruled out - flagging this residual access gap rather than treating the absence as fully exhaustive, though no other decor-relevant sitewide asset (nav, sitemap-index collections, sitemap-index articles) gave any signal of one existing.
